class.name: IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset
class.brief_description: IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset is a unit which is converted from another unit by applying a conversion factor and an offset. HISTORY New entity in IFC 2x4. Example: The temperature unit Fahrenheit is based on the temperature unit Kelvin as follows: f = k · 1.8 – 459.67 wherein k is an absolute temperature expressed in Kelvin and f is the same temperature in Fahrenheit. members.member: A positive or negative offset to add after the inherited ConversionFactor was applied. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
